items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Challenge for MIN: The only trade-eligible players now are Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert, Jaden McDaniels, Donte DiVincenzo, Joan Beringer & Terrence Shannon Jr.

LaMelo Ball & Josh Green can be traded by themselves now or aggregated on Sept. 10.

Waive-and-stretch for Green = $14M < 2nd apron.

items.title: In addition to adding Jonathan Kuminga at ~$6M for next season, Wolves will need to clear enough space to add a vet minimum signing at ~$2.5M. That's to get them back up to 14 players. That means at least $4.1M has to go out to fit everything in under the second-apron hard cap.
